name: DSFR for Drupal - Picker - Link
description: Provides feature to integrate icon picker into link field type.
project_description: Submodule of DSFR for Drupal - Picker. Adds a 'Link with DSFR icon' field widget (plugin id dsfr4drupal_picker_link_icon) for core Link fields, so an editor can attach a DSFR icon to a link alongside its URL and title. The widget subclasses core LinkWidget and mixes in the parent module's PickerWidgetTrait to add the icon picker element and its settings (allowed groups, search input, required). A hook_config_schema_info_alter() implementation registers the extra icon key on the stored link value so the selected icon machine name is saved in the link item's options.
